name: highlights
label: Highlight cards (right of intro)
help_text: Small cards with a magenta left border shown beside the intro.

name: highlight_style
label: Highlight style
help_text: Cards show bordered callouts. Checklist shows compact ticked items, useful for Board/leadership summaries.

name: card_style
label: Card style
help_text: Full shows bio and qualification pill. Compact is best for large grids.

name: data_source
label: Data source
help_text: HubDB is recommended for reuse across pages. Module fields lets you enter people directly in the editor.

name: people
label: People (manual)
help_text: Used when Data source is set to 'Module fields'.

children.name: quals
children.label: Qualifications (pill text)
children.help_text: e.g. IWE, PhD - shown as a badge

name: category_filter
label: Filter by category
help_text: HubDB data source only. Accepts a comma-separated list when set via a template, e.g. "board,corporate". Ignored when grouping is on.

name: category_exclude
label: Exclude categories
help_text: HubDB data source only. Comma-separated categories to leave out, e.g. "board" on a staff-only grid. Applies even when grouping.

name: group_by_category
label: Group people by category
help_text: HubDB data source only. Renders each category as its own titled sub-section, ordered by 'Category order' below. When on, 'Filter by category' is ignored. People with no Category appear under the catch-all heading.

name: category_order
label: Category order
help_text: Order of the grouped sub-sections. Drag rows to reorder. Each name must match a Category value in the HubDB table exactly (including '&' and capitalisation). Categories present in the data but not listed here appear last.

name: ungrouped_heading
label: Heading for people with no category
help_text: HubDB data source only, when grouping is on. Rows whose Category is blank are collected under this heading at the end rather than being dropped from the page.

name: profile_url_base
label: Profile page URL base
help_text: HubDB data source only. Each card links to this path plus the person's HubDB page path, e.g. /about/team/geoff-crittenden. Rows without a page path render as non-clickable cards.

name: view_all_label
label: View all CTA label
help_text: Optional button shown below the people grid. The About page board preview defaults this to 'View all' when left blank.

name: view_all_link
label: View all CTA link
help_text: Optional button link shown below the people grid. The About page board preview defaults this to /about/team when left blank.

name: show_bio_modal
label: Open bio in modal on click
help_text: Not implemented. With the HubDB data source, clicking a card opens that person's profile page instead - see 'Profile page URL base'.

name: section_id
label: Section anchor ID (optional)
help_text: Used for in-page anchor links. Lower-case, hyphenated. Leave blank if not needed.

name: members_only
label: Members only
help_text: When true, this section is only rendered for logged-in active members.
